messages:
michael: Quick sync — target change window 08:00 UTC. Plan: API v1.8.0 (pinned), runtime v2.3.1 (canary then ramp), console v5.6. Router unchanged but will shift traffic rules. Need signoff on pin + rollback triggers.
sara: +1 for the window. how long are we holding canary before ramp?
michael: thinking 10m canary with 5% traffic in us-east-1, then 30m at 25% if metrics look good. fallback to API v1.7.9 pin if latency regresses.
oliver: re: pin — API team confirmed schema compatibility for all current routes. noted a non-breaking header change but SDK teams are fine.
laura: runtime perf test looked good for seq len 1024, but noticed +8ms p50 on small chat (seq 128) under high concurrent execs. ops, do we have quota to scale an extra runtime pod during ramp?
ops-bot: @laura autoscaler alert: cluster-runtime-east has 2 spare nodes, can scale to +4 pods in 120s, cost bump ~3% for window.
sara: if we autoscale during ramp, let's add a cost-aware tag so billing shows the change.
michael: agree. add tag "release=1769003456" to all transient resources.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created:
```
services:
  - name: api
    image: registry/redwood/api:v1.8.0
    pin: true
  - name: runtime
    image: registry/redwood/runtime:v2.3.1
    canary: true
    canary_config: {duration: 600s, initial_traffic: 0.05}
  - name: console
    image: registry/redwood/console:v5.6
    migrate_state: true
routing:
  router: no-change
  traffic_shift: gradual
```
deploy-bot: preflight check results: image signatures OK, migration dry-run OK, no database schema changes detected.
laura: small ask — console migration will flip feature-flag FF_CHAT_VERBOSITY, ops please ensure it's off during canary.
ops-bot: noted. FF_CHAT_VERBOSITY set to OFF for canary lanes.
oliver: two dependency notes: 1) client-sdk v3.2.0 has opt-in for new header; 2) monitoring alert rules updated to include runtime token-drop metric.
michael: rollback criteria proposal: any sustained p50 latency >50ms above baseline for >5m OR error rate increase >0.5% absolute for >5m triggers automatic route rollback to API v1.7.9 and runtime previous revision. Also manual kill switch if canary shows degraded generation quality (eval runner).
sara: thumbs on rollback rules. who will execute manual rollback if auto not triggered?
michael: ops oncall first, then runtime-owner if oncall can't reach. laura OK?
laura: I'll monitor evals + canary traces for first 45m.
ops-bot: scheduled: 2026-04-12T08:00:00Z -> start deploy window. tagging resources with release=1769003456. Alert policy created: channel #eng-oncall and DM to @oliver.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started (us-east-1). 05% traffic to runtime:v2.3.1.
oliver: seeing expected KV cache warmup. no errors so far. latency stable.
sara: console logs show one transient 429 spike at 08:05 from bot spammers, not related.
michael: continue ramp plan at +20% after 12m if metrics green.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 25% at 08:17 UTC.
ops-bot: autoscaler scaled +3 pods in cluster-runtime-east at 08:18 UTC.
laura: eval-runner reports: rouge/bleu metrics stable, small sample quality parity.
michael: approve full ramp in 15m if no regressions.
ops-bot: reminder: budget tag will cause temporary cost delta. billing alerted.
deploy-bot: full ramp to 100% at 08:40 UTC completed.
oliver: runtime logs show two transient OOM events during high fan-in at 08:41, autoscaler replaced pods and memory pressure cleared. no user-facing errors.
sara: we should add a follow-up to increase headroom for small-chat paths. filing a ticket.
michael: agreed — ticket created: RN-642 (increase runtime pool headroom for low-latency flows).
laura: leaving monitoring to catch anything overnight. I'll unpin feature-flag after 24h if stable.
michael: closing — release notes draft: "API v1.8.0: header stabilization; Runtime v2.3.1: perf improvements and kernel updates; Console v5.6: UI polish; no router changes. Canaries successful, no rollback needed." Please review and tag approvals. :tada:
ops-bot: release completed and archived under release/1769003456.
